tone_read: Calm and declarative; 'Evening wind-down' is only a scene-setter for the routine and promises nothing about skin. No fear, hype, urgency or exclamation marks.
language_read: Active and strength are stated precisely (2% Alpha Arbutin), and the supplier line, 18+ suitability and daytime-sunscreen reminder are all straight from the product page. No efficacy claim is made, so no hedging is needed.
